title: Parity prober for typed-output migrations
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: build a parity probing harness that validates typed/structured outputs during model migrations and A/B experiments. This prober focuses on staged verification for migrating from an older model contract to a new one that introduces typed fields (e.g., nested objects, arrays with typed elements, and explicit enum values). Unlike existing shape-diff tools, this harness will: (1) synthesize realistic invocations based on production prompt slices; (2) compute contract divergence metrics (field-level presence, type mismatches, enum drift, and semantically invalid values); (3) run in shadow and A/B modes with weighted sampling and per-candidate scoring; and (4) integrate with auto-rollback when severity thresholds are exceeded. We need a lightweight, low-latency prober suitable for continuous deployment and nightly migration checks.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic generator can produce 10k representative invocations for three production prompt slices within 30m
Divergence scorer produces per-field metrics (presence delta, type mismatch rate, enum drift) and a single composite parity score
Shadow runner hooks into traffic router to mirror 5% of production requests to new variant without impacting latency SLOs
Automated alerting triggers when composite parity score drops below 0.92 for two consecutive windows or when any critical field type mismatch > 0.5%
Playbook documented for manual investigation and rollback with example queries and dashboards
rollout_plan: Phase 0: offline migration checks with synthetic generator and sample logs (QA only). Phase 1: shadow mode on internal traffic (5%) with telemetry collection. Phase 2: guarded A/B (10/90) using canary policy with auto-rollback policy enabled for critical-field mismatches. Phase 3: gradual ramp to full traffic if parity score stabilizes. Each phase requires approval from eng lead + PM and visibility in rollout dashboard.
